title: Update through the recorded distribution
need: yoke update reuses the machine distribution origin/channel, reports verified old/new versions and repairs the credential helper. Distribution is not the active control-plane connection. Missing records need explicit distribution selection. yoke update --check proves the exact installed build: the CLI wheel's full source commit (scm_version.json) must equal the release manifest's source_commit, and the release's published wheel sha256 values are listed; a mismatch refuses installed_build_mismatch with the exact-version reinstall command. With no usable active connection, --check refuses active_connection_unavailable and names `yoke env use <env>` (list with `yoke env list`) instead of a traceback. yoke --version prints only the version.
surface: Install -> upgrade instructions -> CLI/config -> distribution help.
